description: This file defines a PHP class named Item within the Opencart\Catalog\Model\Extension\Opencart\Shipping namespace. The class provides a getQuote method to calculate shipping costs based on cart contents and configuration settings, integrating with Opencart's model, language, and tax systems.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: Provides shipping quote calculation logic based on cart contents and geo zone restrictions within Opencart.
